notes.title: UPDATE 3: Sewer, Boiler Room, and ODDBOT!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=cqgC0jB5w_U;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]What is UP clean-freaks!?[/i] It's been an effing crazy couple of months for the Cleanup Kings, and unfortunately that meant our social media presence going absolutely kaput. Rest assured, the team did NOT drop dead in a horrific indie development accident. In fact, we've been hard at work making some fantastic new additions to our darling, deranged little problem-child, Broombot Battlegrounds -- and today we are FINALLY ready to unveil them to you in this, our third free update for the game!

Thank you to everyone who has wishlisted, purchased, played, reviewed, or even thought about our game in passing up to now! We hope to have even more to share with you all in the coming months. In the meantime, let's see what's new in UPDATE 3!!



[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43547441/284db9b7ae6e728541836112213ad55edafd2aa2.png[/img]
[h1]NEW BATTLE MAP:  SEWER[/h1]
[i]Sewer is a Timed Battle and Last Bot Standing map set in a grimy underground canal. Periodically throughout the match the water level will rapidly rise, temporarily submerging part of the map. If you hear an alarm, head for high ground! Also, be sure to watch out for the creatures that call this level their home... they hate visitors. [/i]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43547441/59ef1b120b795725e56d572e8cceb208fe25cb90.png[/img]
[h1]NEW BATTLE MAP:  BOILER ROOM[/h1]
[i]Boiler Room is a Clean of the Hill and Oddbot map centered around a basement water heater.  Turn valves throughout the level to redirect steam, but each time you do the boiler will get a little more unstable. What happens if you turn all three? We've had this level on the back burner for a while now, and we're super excited to finally show it off![/i]


[h1]NEW GAMEMODE:  ODDBOT[/h1]
[i]A glorious golden crown is hidden somewhere in the level. Find it and vacuum it up! You'll earn a point every second as long as you keep the crown in your dust bag. If you get popped, the crown will be loose and the chase is back on![/i]
[list]
[*] Note: This gamemode is playable on Clean of the Hill maps only!
[/list]

[h2]NEW ACHIEVEMENT ICONS[/h2]
[i]We've completely overhauled our achievement icons with our cute cartoony 2D art style in mind. You can see a couple of them in the collage at the top of this page![/i]

[h2]SINGLE-STICK CONTROLS ARE NOW THE DEFAULT[/h2]
[i]After extensive testing we have found that our single-stick control scheme is much more easily learned than our original twin-stick setup. Because of this, we have decided to make single-stick the default. Twin-stick controls can still be accessed via the Customization Screen for players who prefer that method.[/i]

[h2]NEW MECHANICS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new destructible box that spills out heaps of packing peanuts when destroyed! You can even vacuum up the packing peanuts for points in Clean of the Hill mode!
[*] Added the ability to spike players downward by double jumping above them.
[*] The Repulsion powerup now electrifies standing pools of water on contact, creating a lasting shock hazard.
[*] Broombots that are stunned by Repulsion also electrify standing pools of water on contact.
[*] Added Explosive Barrels that go KABOOM when they come into contact with fire, a bullet, or an explosion from a mine.
[*] Added Mousetraps that attach to the Broombot and apply a temporary slow debuff when driven over.
[*] Added VENTING O_O
[/list]

[h2]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Implemented a better electrocution effect for all shock-damaging hazards.
[*] Added better spark particles to the electricity player death effect.
[*] Modified level difficulty colors to be green for easy, yellow for medium, red for hard.
[*] Juiced up the menu countdown sequence.
[*] Explosions are now scalable (and they scale depending on the object that blows up)
[*] Added additional controls prompts for Single-Stick on the Pause Screen, Main Menu, and Warm-Up Round.
[/list]

[h2]GAME BALANCING[/h2]
[list]
[*] Scaled down the hitbox for the Repulsion powerup (because of its buff)
[*] Dust particles can no longer be vacuumed up in Clean of the Hill if there is a barrier in the way.
[*] Significantly increased score value for vacuumed non-dust debris in Clean of the Hill.
[*] Players now spawn in random positions at the start of each round in Last Bot Standing instead of spawning in the same position.
[*] Slightly increased input sensitivity for single-stick controls.
[*] Improved code that prevents you from respawning too close to opponents in Timed Battle.
[*] Slightly buffed non-braking turn speed for dual stick controls.
[/list]

[h2]BUGFIXES[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where Powerup HUD element disappeared too quickly if certain multi-use abilities were fired in rapid succession.
[*] Improved floor detection to combat an annoying dash recharge bug.
[*] Fixed balloon rotation resetting constantly on lower framerates.
[/list]

[h2]MISCELLANEOUS[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted volume of in-game music tracks for better sound balancing.
[*] Added passive aggressive messages to Warmup Round for players who just won't friggin' ready up already.
[/list]

notes.title: v 1.0.2 -- Getting BUFF(ed)
notes.content:
[i]How's it going Broombotters!?[/i] For those who don't know (because you don't follow our socials -- shame on you), the development team took a little weekend trip to Boston, MA for PAX East 2023 this past month and it was such a surreal, inspiring, all-around INCREDIBLE time!

We met so many great players, content creators, and fellow devs, and by the end of the convention we had a [b]loooot[/b] of feedback to sort through. By the time we made it back home in one piece (except for our Broombot friend who got taken apart by airport security, r.i.p.), we were already hard at work on some brand new features and improvements for the game -- which we will be sharing with you RIGHT NOW!

Here is what's new in version 1.0.2 of Broombot Battlegrounds!


[h1]NEW FEATURE: Single-Joystick Controls[/h1]
[i]This was one of the most requested new features by far! We hope this new control option will help players who have been struggling with our default twin-stick movement.[/i]
[list]
[*] Players may now toggle between Twin-Stick and Single-Stick movement controls in the Customization Screen
[*] Each player can set their own movement controls independently No need for everyone to play the same way!
[/list]

[h1]NEW FEATURE: Automatic Docking[/h1]
[list]
[*] Players can now toggle whether or not they need to press a button to begin depositing their dust in Gameplay Settings
[*] If automatic docking is enabled, depositing dust in Clean of the Hill mode will start as soon as the player enters the vicinity of their docking station with at least one dust collected
[/list]

[h1]NEW ACHIEVEMENTS![/h1]
[i]Ace in the Hole[/i]: Play a game of Pool in the Basement
[i]Putting on the Potty[/i]: Do some golfing in the Bathroom

[h1]Map Improvements[/h1]
[h2]Classic Diner[/h2]
[list]
[*] Utensil Cup now increments the score of the player that pushed it over if an opponent's balloon is popped by one of the hazards in the cup
[*] Utensils can be moved/launched by powerup effects. If this results in a kill, the player using the powerup will be credited to kill
[*] Adjusted scaling of booth seats
[/list]
[h2]Box Factory[/h2]
[list]
[*] Gave destructible boxes a brand new look and functionality
[*] Destructible boxes now contain packing peanuts and other tasty goodies
[*] Destructible boxes can now be destroyed by powerup effects
[/list]
[h2]Island[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added electricity particles around power outlet (watch your knives)
[/list]
[h2]Playpen[/h2]
[list]
[*] Electricity particles added to power outlet here as well
[/list]
[h2]Classroom[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted collision under the table
[*] Blocked off area behind the big teddy bear so that he can't swallow players whole anymore
[/list]
[h2]Attic[/h2]
[list]
[*] Adjusted collision on ironing board stand
[*] Improved visual effect for electrified wet floor
[/list]
[h2]Basement[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added new destructible boxes to the level to give players on the outskirts of the level something to break (AND you can suck up the packing peanuts for points, yumm)
[*] Adjusted collision behind washing machine for better maneuverability
[/list]
[h2]Sudden Death[/h2]
[list]
[*] Replaced the knife hazards with buzzsaws because buzzsaws are way cooler
[*] Adjusted playable bounds
[/list]

[h1]Powerup Improvements[/h1]
[i]We beefed up a TON of our powerups for better utility and readability! Also they just look plain better now.[/i]
[h2]Repulsion[/h2]
[list]
[*] Can no longer be used through walls and floors
[*] Visual effect now changes depending on player color
[*] Opponents are now temporarily stunned for 2 seconds when hit by the repulsion effect
[*] Added an electrical particle effect around players that are hit by the repulsion effect
[/list]
[h2]Dust Vortex[/h2]
[list]
[*] Players are no longer invincible while the effect is active
[*] Opponents are now pushed away much more consistently by the vortex force
[*] Fixed issue where using vortex causes the player to spin out uncontrollably in certain areas
[/list]
[h2]Mine[/h2]
[list]
[*] Mine explosions now ignite oil slicks. Players caught in the resulting fire go out in a blaze of glory.
[*] Oil fire goes away after 10 seconds. Oil slicks can be reignited multiple times
[/list]
[h2]Teleport[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a brand new, much juicier visual effect for the powerup to increase readability and awesomeness.
[*] User now destroys surrounding opponents at the moment a teleport has finished executing within a certain radius. Nearby opponents who are outside of this area of effect are launched away instead
[*] Fixed issue where balloon is able to clip into the Broombot after that player has used the teleport ability.
[/list]
[h2]Gun[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new muzzle flash effect
[*] Bullets now break and pass through destructible boxes
[/list]
[h2]Hyper-Dash[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a slick new electricity effect to the dash trail
[*] Hyper-Dash users can now charge through opponents to destroy them rather than having to aim for balloons. This effect goes away after the ability has been expended
[/list]

[h1]Quality of Life Additions[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a controls diagram to Warmup Round that new and returning players can refer to
[*] Added additional flavor text to Warmup Round to distinguish it from other modes
[*] Added new carpet meshes to improve readability of slowing areas
[*] Added map difficulty identifiers to the Level Select screen to help newer players
[*] Added button indicator to the powerup HUD icon to help new players learn how to use abilities
[*] Added more menu options to the Pause Screen and Win Screen for easier navigation
[*] Improved visual readability and collision for all oil slicks and slippery water puddles
[*] Made Easy AI players even easier because even at that difficulty they were still terminators
[/list]

[h1]Game Balancing Changes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Dust spawn rate now increases based on how much time is remaining in the match during Clean of the Hill mode
[*] Halved the stun duration from knife-to-wall collisions
[*] Reduced dust bag capacity to 400 in Clean of the Hill mode to encourage more map rotation via returning to the docking station
[/list]

[h1]Miscellaneous Bugfixes and Random Juicy Bits[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a dust cloud particle effect that appears behind the Broombot when charging up a dash
[*] Water now creates a splashing effect when any physics object falls in, not just the Broombot. It even goes "splish splish"
[*] Added controller feedback for when players pop a fake powerup balloon
[*] Fixed issue where Vortex powerup HUD icon disappears before effect has ended
[*] Added code to help prevent players from being able to clip into each other during certain collisions
[*] Fixed a major camera glitch in splitscreen mode caused by controller misassignment
[*] Fixed issue where Broombot debris pieces weren't affected by the conveyor belt
[*] Fixed issue where amount of games played was capped at 50 in the Stats Screen
[*] Added code to help prevent incidence of issue where the player's balloon separates from its body
[*] Began prototyping new gamemode
[*] Programmed the Broombots to feel pain
[/list]

notes.title: v1.0.1 -- Broombot's First Update!
notes.content:
[h1][b]Broombot Battlegrounds Update 1: Hotfixes, Balance Adjustments, and other goodies[/b][/h1]

[i]Howdy folks![/i] We've had a wild couple of weeks since our game officially launched back in February, and it's been an absolute joy seeing all the support for the game we've received thus far. Can't say it enough -- THANK YOU ALL SO MUCH!!

Since release we've received some fantastic constructive player feedback, and we are currently working to provide steady improvements and additions to the game based on suggestions and comments y'all have been providing. Today's is just the [i]first[/i] of several free updates we have planned for Broombot going forward, and we hope you guys will stay tuned as we hope to have a lot more to share very soon!

With that out of the way, here's what's new in version 1.0.1 of Broombot Battlegrounds!


[h2]Keyboard Support Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added key prompts to all menus and in-game that replace button prompts if keyboard input is detected
[*] Adjusted keyboard controls to be a little more user-friendly
[/list]

[h2]Game Balancing Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reduced wall collision rebound force so that it's easier to navigate precarious platforming areas
[*] Increased jump height slightly to make platforming a bit easier
[*] Reduced respawn time by 1 second so that you can get back into the action faster
[*] Lowered default AI difficulty to Easy because dang those bots are evil
[*] Added invincibility frames after you deposit dust so that one annoying friend you have can't wait by your docking station and pop you immediately after you finish putting dust in
[*] Reduced the scale of the Knife's hitbox so that it isn't able to reach as far
[*] Reduced cooldown on environmental collisions, preventing some weird physics happenings
[/list]

[h2]Menu / UI Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed significant performance issues caused by main menus. We're not trying to melt GPUs out here, we swear.
[*] Adjusted background colors in Credits to be less harsh
[*] Added a fun little screen that reminds players that we are compatible with Steam Remote Play (and that you need multiple controllers to play multiplayer)
[/list]

[h2]Powerup Adjustments[/h2]
[list]
[*] Significantly increased the spawn rate of powerup balloons when frequency is set to Chaotic.
[*] Powerups can no longer be used while depositing dust in Clean of the Hill mode
[/list]
[h3]Gun[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted vertical positioning of the spawn point of the bullet, making it easier to hit its target
[/list]

[h2]Level Improvements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Doubled amount of Powerup Spawn locations for more variety
[*] Added/adjusted collision in certain areas to prevent issues
[*] Removed material striping issue caused by incorrect shading in certain areas of the level
[/list]
[h3]Garden[/h3]
[list]
[*] Shrunk hitboxes on thorn bushes so it's harder to get popped by them
[*] Added foliage elements and better borders for muddy sections of the map because it looked nice
[/list]
[h3]Classic Diner[/h3]
[list]
[*] Chef's knife no longer phases through reality to hit its target
[*] Lowered the amount of time it takes for utensil hazards to be phased out
[*] Made it so that Utensil Cups can be affected by physics impulses from powerups
[/list]
[h3]Aquarium[/h3]
[list]
[*] Adjusted placement of elements inside the drainable tank
[/list]
[h3]Island[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added more visual details to the broken blender and sink
[/list]
[h3]Hardhat Zone[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a killbox underneath the forklift platform so you get crushed when it lowers
[*] Added additional visual assets to highlight certain level hazards
[/list]
[h3]Playpen[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added a hidden hint that will help you guys find one of the secret achievements
[/list]
[h3]Kindergarten[/h3]
[list]
[*] Made the same adjustments to pencil cups as utensil cups in Diner (affected by powerups and phasing out sooner)
[/list]
[h3]Home Gym[/h3]
[list]
[*] Lowered fan intensity
[*] Dust will no longer spawn on the treadmill belt
[*] Added more boing sounds when bouncing off of stuff. Gotta love boing sounds.
[/list]
[h3]Attic[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dust no longer spawns on spike-boards, making it easier to recover
[/list]

[h2]Achievements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed "Not in Kansas Anymore" so that it triggers properly
[*] Adjusted verbiage of "Unlucky" to properly reflect the unlocking condition of that achievement
[/list]




Thank you for reading the notes, you are rad. As a reward here's a little glimpse at some OTHER stuff we've been cooking up in the Broombot kitchen. Stay clean, Broombotters!
